description.p: Salt is a fast, open-source bootstrapper for running Roblox Studio on Linux, written in Rust. It is a rewrite of Vinegar by VinegarHQ and shares its data and configuration.
Studio starts faster: Wine boots once, alongside the update check, instead of twice.
Lost DNS replies are resent after 1 second instead of 5.
Dark mode: an Appearance setting (Automatic, Light or Dark) for Salt and its settings window.
The icon in Salt's title bars always contrasts with the title bar, even when the taskbar icon is set to white.
The logo inside Salt's windows now always contrasts with the window background, and a "Salt Settings" entry opens the settings from any app launcher.
New app icon in black and white versions, following the desktop's light or dark theme, with a setting to choose one manually.
Rewrite of Vinegar in Rust: faster setup and installs, Studio logs read from files instead of Wine's debug channel, fixes for DNS stalls and log spam, and an MCP bridge for Roblox Studio.
